Open • FLYBYME (Tim) opened about 1 minute ago • 0 comments


  The server half landed (FLYBYME/surfdns#62):  telem.ingest  accepts batches,
  writes to a collection                                                      
  and a file, is configurable per site, and rate-limits anonymous callers. The
  cdn and api log                                                             
  their own requests into the same sink.                                      
                                                                              
  Nothing sends anything from a browser. That is this issue.                  
                                                                              
  ## Build the  telem  Extension in mesh-core                                 
                                                                              
  It collects from the page and POSTs batches to  telem.ingest .              
                                                                              
  The contract is already written — read it rather than inventing a shape:    
                                                                              
  •  mesh-serve/src/telem/schema/telem.ts  —  TelemIngestInputSchema  is      
   { sessionId, host?, events[] } , at most 100 events per batch              
  •  TelemEventInputSchema  is  .strict() , so an unknown field is a rejected 
  batch. The fields are                                                       
  grouped by  type :  log ,  call ,  boot ,  error ,  request                 
  •  telem.ingest  is  visibility: 'public'  — a page that has not signed in  
  still boots, still                                                          
  fails, and is exactly when the logs matter                                  
                                                                              
  ## What to collect                                                          
                                                                              
  • log — the kernel already buffers these ( createLogBuffer  in mesh-web) and
  nothing ships them                                                          
  anywhere                                                                    
  • call — key,  durationMs ,  outcome ,  errorKind ,  status . Never inputs. 
  • boot —  partId ,  order ,  bootStatus . Which parts mounted, in what order,
  which did not                                                               
  • error — unhandled errors and rejections, with  stack                      
  • session — one stable  sessionId  per page load, so a visit is one thread  
                                                                              
  ## The three things that make this hard                                     
                                                                              
  1. It must not be able to break a page. An extension that throws while      
  activating, or blocks                                                       
  boot on a POST, is worse than no telemetry. Fail closed and silent. RULES §9
  in mesh-operator                                                            
  says the same thing about every part; this is the one where it will actually
  be tested.                                                                  
  2. The last batch must survive the tab closing. Flush on  visibilitychange ,
  and use                                                                     
   navigator.sendBeacon  where it exists — a normal  fetch  in  unload  is    
  cancelled.                                                                  
  3. Volume. Every call from every page, unbounded, fills a disk. Batch,      
  debounce, and respect                                                       
  the per-site config the server already holds.                               
                                                                              
  ## Privacy is part of the design                                            
                                                                              
  Never send ticket values, passwords, or form contents. Call keys and        
  outcomes, not arguments. The                                                
  server's schema is built for that; do not work around it. Say in your       
  closing comment what you send                                               
  and what you deliberately do not — that list is as much the deliverable as  
  the code.                                                                   
                                                                              
  ## Not in scope                                                             
                                                                              
  A UI for reading it.  telem.query  exists on the server; the screen is a    
  later issue.
